item.title: Middle East War Raises Concerns For Malaysia’s Health Care System — Dr Hoomashini Gunasegaran, Dr Sean Thum & Dr Tharani Loganathan
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia does have buffers, including energy revenues and existing subsidy frameworks, but these alone are not sufficient. What is needed is a more anticipatory approach that protects access to health care and nutrition while strengthening system resilience.
